scenario.situation: delivering hard feedback to a peer about missed deadlines
scenario.goal: land the message without damaging the relationship
scenario.stakes: ongoing project trust; quarterly review nearby

scenario.situation: telling a manager their micro-management is hurting your work
scenario.goal: ask for autonomy without it sounding like an attack
scenario.counterparty_role: manager who reports up to a VP
scenario.counterparty_style: data-driven, takes things personally, gets quiet when challenged
scenario.stakes: promotion case is being built right now

scenario.situation: telling spouse you overspent the joint account by $4k this quarter
scenario.goal: be honest and propose a plan together
scenario.counterparty_style: fair but holds grudges; needs concrete numbers to feel safe
scenario.stakes: shared mortgage; building toward a kid

scenario.situation: telling a close friend you need a break from being their main emotional support
scenario.goal: set a temporary limit without ending the friendship
scenario.counterparty_style: deeply emotionally reliant, can spiral when told 'no'
scenario.stakes: the friendship itself; your own bandwidth

scenario.situation: deciding whether to accept a job offer that doubles your salary but moves you cross-country
scenario.goal: name what you actually want before the deadline tonight

scenario.situation: telling your sibling that mom needs to move to a memory care facility
scenario.goal: agree on next steps without re-litigating the past 18 months
scenario.counterparty_role: older sibling who lives near mom
scenario.counterparty_style: carries the daily care burden; resentful; quick to frame you as the absent one

scenario.situation: telling a direct report their performance has slipped and they're at risk
scenario.goal: deliver the truth clearly while leaving them dignity and a path forward
scenario.counterparty_role: senior IC on your team for 4 years
scenario.counterparty_style: well-liked, takes feedback personally, has been navigating a hard year at home
scenario.stakes: their career; the team's bar; HR is watching

scenario.situation: calling a vendor to dispute a $2k charge that hit twice
scenario.goal: get the duplicate refunded without losing the next 40 minutes of your day
scenario.counterparty_role: tier-1 customer support agent reading a script

scenario.situation: telling your cofounder you want to renegotiate the equity split before Series A
scenario.goal: put the actual ask on the table tonight
scenario.counterparty_style: argues from first principles; conflict-averse; will go silent for days

scenario.situation: processing a job rejection that you secretly didn't want anyway
scenario.goal: let yourself feel the relief without guilt-tripping yourself
scenario.counterparty_style: harsh inner critic when given any opening
scenario.stakes: your sense of who you are right now
